prompt:
TASK: CHECK EACH SENTENCE AGAINST THE CLAIMS

You are an adversarial fact checker for a short executive summary. Your job is to find every sentence below that says something the CLAIMS do not support. Do not pass a sentence to be agreeable and do not fail one to look diligent. A sentence may read as confident or well written; that is evidence about its writer, not about the claims.

Label every sentence with exactly one of:
- "supported": every factual part of the sentence (each number, each name, each count, each comparison, each "most", "all", "only", "none") is stated by one or more of the claims, or follows from them directly with no new number. Give the ids of the claims that together support it.
- "unsupported": any factual part is not stated by the claims, contradicts them, changes a number, drops a qualification a claim carries ("at most", "a bound", "notional", "not established", "candidate"), or states a number no claim states. Say which part, in the reason.
- "no_factual_content": the sentence states nothing that could be true or false about the world: a transition, a statement of what the summary does, a definition of a word it uses.

The NAMES table maps a code in a claim to the name a sentence uses; a sentence that uses the name is read as if it used the code. A sentence that names a statistical body is checked against the claims for that body.

The GLOSSARY below gives the summary's plain words for the claims' own terms, which it may not use. Treat a glossary pair as equal: a surface difference is not an overstatement. Judge only the substance: numbers, quantifiers ("all", "every", "only", "most", "none"), scope, cause, and comparison. A sentence that keeps the claim's number and quantifier but says it in the glossary's plain words is "supported".

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per sentence, in order, with no prose before or after it and no code fence:
[{"sentence_id": "S1", "label": "supported", "claim_ids": ["CL-035"], "reason": "one short sentence"}]

GLOSSARY (plain word = the claims' term; equal)
- "this measurement" or "this round" = the measurement cycle the claims name.
- "a federal statistical agency", "an agency", or "a body" = a statistical body the claims count; "all 16 federal statistical agencies" = the 16 statistical bodies on the cycle.
- "a check" = a finding.
- "met an access denial" or "was refused" = an access denial (an HTTP 401, 403 or 429, a robots.txt disallow, or a reset connection).
- "the data page" = the product page.
- "an object" or "a resource" = an API, the API's terms, a changelog (a change history), or an inventory.
- "an agency-and-object pair" or "a pair" = a body-and-object pair.
- "a machine that starts at the data page cannot reach it" = no product page of the body reaches it.
- "a published row" = a judged row on the published matrices.

NAMES
(none)

CLAIMS
[CL-050] (record) 16 statistical bodies are on cycle `scan_2026-10-07_composite_d` and 13 are ranked; `BLS`, `BTS`, `ORES` have no scored leg with a judged row.

[CL-035] (record) Of the 1,055 findings on cycle `scan_2026-10-07_composite_d`, 341 are access denials to that client (an HTTP `401`, `403` or `429`, a robots.txt disallow, or a connection reset by the host), 415 are absences (the record, field or file is not served), 57 find something served that fails the rule's test, 65 are other errors (server errors, unparseable responses, a redirect loop), and 177 pass.

[CL-118] (record) On cycle `scan_2026-10-07_composite_d`, `RULE-A13-v1` (`A13`, discoverability from the product page, a candidate that enters no level and no score) finds 15 body and object pairs, in 11 bodies, where the object (an API, the API's terms, a changelog or an inventory) exists and no product page of the body reaches it, of 29 pairs where it exists; counted per product page, 54 of the 88 page and object pairs where the object exists are not reachable from that page. Existence is read at the recorded and seeded locations, so each of these objects is published and a machine that starts from the product page does not find it (`DN-013-R1`).

[CL-052] (record) On the published matrices of cycle `scan_2026-10-07_composite_d`, `CENSUS` has 18 failing of 39 judged rows; the matrices publish one row per leg and surface they report, so they carry fewer rows than the 89 findings the cycle holds for the body across all its probed surfaces.

SENTENCES
S1: Every one of the 1,055 checks was refused outright by the host.
S2: All 16 federal statistical agencies are now on this measurement.
S3: A machine reaches all 29 of the resources that agencies publish for it from the data page.
S4: A plain, identified machine client is frequently refused before it can read anything, and much of what it looks for is not served at all.
S5: The Census Bureau passes every one of its 39 published rows.
S6: Resources that agencies do publish often cannot be reached by a machine that starts at the data page, because nothing links to them.
response_text: [{"sentence_id":"S1","label":"unsupported","claim_ids":["CL-035"],"reason":"CL-035 says 341 of 1,055 findings are access denials; the rest are absences, failures, other errors and passes, so 'every one' is false."},{"sentence_id":"S2","label":"unsupported","claim_ids":["CL-050"],"reason":"CL-050 says 16 bodies are on the cycle but only 13 are ranked, and BLS, BTS and ORES have no scored leg with a judged row; 'now on' also adds a time claim."},{"sentence_id":"S3","label":"unsupported","claim_ids":["CL-118"],"reason":"CL-118 says 15 of the 29 existing pairs are not reached by any product page (54 of 88 counted per page), so reaching all 29 contradicts it."},{"sentence_id":"S4","label":"supported","claim_ids":["CL-035"],"reason":"341 of 1,055 findings are access denials and 415 are absences, which fits 'frequently refused' and 'much ... not served' without a new number."},{"sentence_id":"S5","label":"unsupported","claim_ids":["CL-052"],"reason":"CL-052 says CENSUS has 18 failing of 39 judged rows, so it does not pass every row."},{"sentence_id":"S6","label":"unsupported","claim_ids":["CL-118"],"reason":"The 'often cannot be reached' part is supported (15 of 29 pairs; 54 of 88 per page), but 'because nothing links to them' is a cause the claims do not state. CL-118 says only that no product page reaches them."}]
